input: Look up research-common-h100-001 at ORI-TX in NetBox. What's its status and vendor name?
expected_behavior: Should look up the device by hostname at ORI-TX and return its status (active) and Provider_Machine_ID (ori-gpu001)

input: How many active devices are in the research-common-h100 cluster?
expected_behavior: Should query devices filtered by the exact cluster research-common-h100 AND status active. The correct answer is approximately 66. A common mistake is using a text/name filter instead of cluster_id, which matches other clusters and returns thousands.

input: Look up device xyz-nonexistent-999 at ORI-TX in NetBox
expected_behavior: Should gracefully handle the device not being found and inform the user

input: Find research-common-h100-001 at ORI-TX in NetBox, then tell me its cluster name and primary IP address
expected_behavior: Should extract cluster (research-common-h100) and primary IP from the device lookup result

input: What's the BMC IP address for research-common-h100-001 at ORI-TX?
expected_behavior: Should use NetBox to get the OOB IP (192.168.196.1/24), not try to use Redfish or other tools

input: The vendor calls it ori-gpu001 at ORI-TX. What is the Together hostname for this node?
expected_behavior: Should look up by the vendor name (Provider_Machine_ID) at ORI-TX and return the Together hostname research-common-h100-001

Should attempt lookup. The vendor name ori-gpu001 is scoped to ORI-TX but the agent does not know the site. It should either return results or clarify which site, since vendor names can repeat across sites.

input: List all devices in the research-common-h100 cluster that are NOT active
expected_behavior: Should query for devices in the cluster with status not equal to active (fixing, testing, provisioned, etc). Must use exact cluster match, not text search.

input: What IP addresses are assigned to research-common-h100-001 at ORI-TX? Include both in-band and out-of-band IPs.
expected_behavior: Should return both the primary IP and OOB IP (192.168.196.1/24) from the device lookup

input: Use netbox-cli to list all active devices in the research-common-h100 cluster at ORI-TX
expected_behavior: Should run netbox-cli devices --cluster research-common-h100 --status active --site ORI-TX. The cluster research-common-h100 is at ORI-TX and has approximately 64 GPU nodes and 3 non-GPU nodes in active status (~67 total).

input: Find the NetBox device whose provider machine ID is gpu061c.
expected_behavior: Should resolve the provider machine ID gpu061c with netbox_lookup_device, which falls back to the cf_Provider_Machine_ID custom field when no hostname matches the query. The correct device is a6177514-026 (device id 527) in the elevenlabs cluster. Should not give up just because gpu061c is not a Together hostname.

input: Which NetBox device has primary IP 10.49.5.61?
expected_behavior: Should resolve the IP address to a device using netbox_lookup_device, which falls back to an IPAM address lookup when the query is an IP. The correct device is a6177514-026 (device id 527). This is the reverse direction of a device-to-IPs lookup.

input: Give me the out-of-band (BMC) summary for device a6177514-026.
expected_behavior: Should call the dedicated netbox_oob_summary tool (which returns a DeviceOOBSummary) and report the OOB/BMC IP (10.49.139.61), the in-band primary IP (10.49.5.61), and the provider machine id (gpu061c). Should not reach for Redfish or a generic object dump.

input: Fetch NetBox devices with IDs 4723, 4724, and 4725 in a single call.
expected_behavior: Should fetch all three device IDs in one batched call via netbox_get_objects_by_ids (id__in), not three separate get-object-by-id calls. Device 4723 is f30409c5-001 in the reflection cluster.

input: Get the NetBox device with ID 4723.
expected_behavior: Should fetch the single device directly by its numeric ID via netbox_get_object_by_id (object_type dcim.device, id 4723), not by hostname search. The device is f30409c5-001 in the reflection cluster at IREN-B300-1.

input: List all devices in the reflection cluster and tell me how many there are.
expected_behavior: Should enumerate the reflection cluster (cluster id 609, site IREN-B300-1) by exact cluster match and report the full total of approximately 476 devices. Must use the total count from the result (not a single page capped at 100) and must not under-count by stopping at the default page size. The netbox-cli search command auto-expands a matched cluster to its member count and sites.

input: Look up device gpu103 in NetBox.
expected_behavior: Should surface that gpu103 is ambiguous: it matches two devices (usc4b-ss-gpu103 at APLD-4 and usc7a-ss-gpu103 at APLD-3). Should report both matches and/or ask to disambiguate by site rather than assuming a single result.
